The web app

spezado serve serves the web app and the API on this device, at http://127.0.0.1:8048 (another port with --port). Nothing is loaded from elsewhere – no fonts, no scripts, no tracking.

spezado serve
# spezado serves at http://127.0.0.1:8048
# Pair a device with the code 6958d36774 – or open http://127.0.0.1:8048/#pair=6958d36774

In the menu bar

spezado tray runs the same server with an icon in the menu bar (macOS) or the system tray (Windows): Open spezado opens the web app, Pair a device … makes a new pairing code and opens the pairing link, Start at login starts it whenever you log in, Quit spezado stops it. Like serve, it creates the workspace if there is none. The release builds have it on macOS and Windows; on Linux, spezado serve runs without an icon. On Windows, started at login, it still keeps a console window open (OPEN).

spezado tray
spezado autostart on      # start at login: `tray` where there is one, else `serve`; `off` to stop, none to ask

Apps that start spezado themselves give it the pairing code in SPEZADO_PAIRING_CODE – at least 16 letters, digits, - or _ – and pair with it at once.

Other devices

To reach spezado from a phone, a tablet or an app in the same network, let it listen there – only over TLS:

spezado serve --listen 0.0.0.0:8443 --host laptop.local

It makes a certificate of the workspace’s own for the host name and keeps it. The pairing link carries the certificate’s fingerprint and is printed as a QR code: an app checks the fingerprint, a browser asks once whether to trust the certificate. A server with a domain can put a reverse proxy with a certificate of its own in front instead (Synchronisation, running a relay).

Pairing

Every browser is paired once: open the address with #pair=… that serve shows, or enter the code on the page. The code is valid for a quarter of an hour and for one device; a new start of serve shows a new one. The browser keeps the token it receives; another browser needs a code of its own.

The pages

Page  
Overview bank and cash, income, expenses and result of the year, the next advance VAT return and when it is due; the state and the permanent extension that move deadlines, changed from a date on; synchronisation – starting it, the devices, inviting one, synchronising now (Synchronisation)
Journal every booking, reversals
Bank read statements, book entries or accept the proposals
Documents read e-invoices into booking proposals, file other documents, download every original
Invoices the seller’s details, customers, invoices written as XRechnung or ZUGFeRD (Invoices)
Accounts balances, ledgers, opening balances
Reports the reports of the year, as CSV, too; the filings prepared from them (Filings)
Review what needs review, in words
Closing closing periods, the GoBD data transfer

Without books, the web app sets up new ones – or brings them from another device, with an invitation or the recovery code. While serve runs, it synchronises every minute.

+ Buchen / + Book books from a gross amount or in lines. The language (German, English) and light or dark – or like the system – are chosen at the top and kept in the browser. What another browser, the terminal or the command line writes shows up at once.
